Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 544 PM EST Sun Nov 22 2026
 

- Light rain showers this evening. 

- Much colder temperatures start tomorrow and through through the 
week. 

- Lake effect rain/snow to snow shower potential tomorrow afternoon 
and evening.

&&

.AVIATION...

A well defined cold front will continue its eastward progression 
across Se Mi during the first hour of the TAF period. The front will 
be accompanied by a band of rain showers with MVFR and sporadic IFR 
restrictions due to both visibility's and ceilings. The passage of 
the front will be marked by a wind shift to roughly 290 to 310 
degrees. Increased post frontal mixing through cold air advection 
will boost post frontal gusts around 20 knots, lasting through the 
evening. Observational trends are supportive of a region of post 
frontal MVFR based stratus. Aggressive post frontal subsidence will 
offer high probabilities for clearing skies overnight. Diurnal 
mixing combined with the cold air advection across the Great Lakes 
will result in an expanding VFR based strato cu field Monday 
afternoon.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for cigs aob 5000 feet this evening. Low overnight and Monday 
  morning. Moderate Monday afternoon.
